raw_response: The figure presents a clustered bar chart illustrating the annual land area in hectares for several countries over a period of years. The horizontal axis represents the years from 2013 to 2022, with each year labeled and evenly spaced. The vertical axis represents the land area in hectares, ranging from 0 to 1200, with tick marks at intervals of 100 and labeled with corresponding hectare values. The data is grouped by country, with each country represented by a different color: Spain (purple), France (red), China/Continental (gray), Italy (yellow), Turkey (green), USA (blue), and Argentina (black). Each year displays a cluster of bars, one for each country, allowing for a visual comparison of land area across countries for each year. For example, in 2013, China/Continental has a land area of approximately 900 hectares, while Italy has approximately 300 hectares. The bars are arranged in descending order of height within each year, with the highest value generally observed for China/Continental. There are no visual enhancements such as shading or bolding applied to any of the bars.
